$schema_note: Prompt set for the corpus's `kimodo` motion source per RFD 2203. Each entry is a licence-clean text prompt authored by weftspun (no third-party motion names, no branded exemplars per CLAUDE.md's trademark rule), plus a per-prompt seed and target duration. The renderer's `_run_upstream` reads this file, feeds each prompt to Kimodo at the specified seed and duration, and produces the .npz frames per prompt. Every subset rendered from this source carries `motion_source=kimodo` + `synthetic_class=constructed-renders-over-generated-poses` and CLAUDE.md's four generated-synthetic conditions bind.

motion_source.name: kimodo
motion_source.description: Kimodo emits (T, 77, 3, 3) local rotation matrices per prompt per seed. Poses are generated synthetic under CLAUDE.md's four conditions; the corpus records generator + checkpoint + prompt + seed per subset in the shard manifest.

sampler_config_template.notes: sampler_config recorded per shard as manifest.sampler_config.kimodo (a sub-object under the existing sampler_config with the Mitsuba knobs). Any refinement subset that swaps the checkpoint or changes the sampler knobs is a new commit set with prior hash cited, per RFD 2203 living-dataset doctrine.

prompts.$note: Categorised so a subset can subselect (e.g. subset-01 uses only 'locomotion' + 'transitions'; subset-02 adds 'gestures'). Category is recorded in the shard's manifest under motion_source.categories.

locomotion.prompt: A person walking forward at a natural pace on flat ground, arms swinging naturally
A person walking briskly forward on flat ground, longer stride, arms swinging widely
A person walking forward and turning left through a gentle curve
A person walking forward and turning right through a gentle curve
A person walking forward, then decelerating to a stop and standing still
A person walking backward at a slow pace, arms held out slightly for balance
A person side-stepping to their own left, feet crossing over
A person side-stepping to their own right, feet crossing over
A person jogging forward at a steady pace, arms bent at the elbow, feet slightly off the ground
A person running forward, arms pumping, longer time in the air between footfalls

transitions.prompt: A person standing upright, then bending at the knees and hips to crouch down low, arms coming forward for balance
A person crouching low, then straightening the legs and rising to a standing pose, arms falling to the sides
A person standing, then lowering themselves to sit cross-legged on the floor
A person sitting cross-legged on the floor, then rising to a standing pose using one hand for balance
A person standing, then bending at the knees and hips to sit down on an imagined chair behind them
A person sitting on an imagined chair, then rising to a standing pose
A person standing, then kneeling down onto both knees, torso upright
A person kneeling on both knees, then rising to a standing pose one leg at a time

gestures.prompt: A person standing still, raising their own right arm and waving the hand side to side above shoulder height
A person standing still, raising their own left arm and waving the hand side to side above shoulder height
A person standing still, extending their own right arm straight forward with the index finger pointing
A person standing still, raising their own right fist to chest height and extending the thumb up
A person standing still, nodding the head down and up twice, torso still
A person standing still, turning the head side to side twice, torso still
A person standing still, raising both shoulders toward the ears then lowering them, palms turning outward
A person standing still, crossing both arms in front of the chest, forearms overlapping

idle.prompt: A person standing still with arms hanging naturally at the sides, weight even on both feet, gentle breathing
A person standing, gently shifting weight from one foot to the other, arms hanging naturally
A person standing still, turning the head left, then right, then centre, torso upright

provenance.condition_1_generator: Kimodo-SOMA-RP-v1.1 checkpoint (NVIDIA Open Model License) invoked at the per-prompt seed above; each shard's manifest records the checkpoint hash + the prompt text + the seed under sampler_config.kimodo
provenance.condition_2_stored_separately: this file names motion_source=kimodo; the shard manifest's motion_source field records it, distinct from any soma-library subset per RFD 2203 living-dataset doctrine
provenance.condition_3_not_sole_distribution: the corpus MUST also carry at least one soma-library (constructed-pose) subset before any training run consumes it. `check_corpus_manifest.py` asserts this at corpus level (task 3 gate extension)
provenance.condition_4_evaluation_on_real_or_constr: blinded holdout coco_person_commercial_val2017 remains the evaluation set per CLAUDE.md; kimodo subsets are training-only

authoring.task: HERD 2026-09-04 task 2: author the Kimodo prompt set as data, licence-clean, trademark-safe vocabulary, no third-party motion names
authoring.notes: Prompts are original text authored for this corpus. No branded exemplars per CLAUDE.md trademark rule (no franchise-named moves, no third-party dance names, no branded fighting-game motions). Reference vocabulary is anatomical (joint names, weight-shift language) rather than referential.
